lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਪਹਰ ਪਹਰ ਤੇ ਘਰੀਆਂ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: din te pahar pahar te ghareeaa(n) aav ghatai tan chheejai ||
lines.translation: Day by day, hour by hour, life runs its course, and the body withers away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਅਹੇਰੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਧਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaal aheree phirai badhik jiu kahahu kavan bidh keejai ||1||
lines.translation: Death, like a hunter, a butcher, is on the prowl; tell me, what can we do? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਆਵਨ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: so din aavan laagaa ||
lines.translation: That day is rapidly approaching.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਕਾ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa bhaaee sut banitaa kahahu kooo hai kaa kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse - tell me, who belongs to whom? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਰਤੈ ਆਪਾ ਪਸੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab lag jot kaaiaa mahi baratai aapaa pasoo na boojhai ||
lines.translation: As long as the light remains in the body, the beast does not understand himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: laalach karai jeevan pad kaaran lochan kachhoo na soojhai ||2||
lines.translation: He acts in greed to maintain his life and status, and sees nothing with his eyes. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re praanee chhodahu man ke bharamaa ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal: Renounce the doubts of your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਰਹੁ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਂ ॥੩॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: keval naam japahu re praanee parahu ek kee saranaa(n) ||3||2||
lines.translation: Chant only the One Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortal, and seek the Sanctuary of the One Lord. ||3||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕਾਹੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan bhaau bhagat kachh jaanai taa kau acharaj kaaho ||
lines.translation: That humble being, who knows even a little about loving devotional worship - what surprises are there for him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਪੈਸਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਢੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jal jal mahi pais na nikasai tiu dhur milio julaaho ||1||
lines.translation: Like water, dripping into water, which cannot be separated out again, so is the weaver Kabeer, with softened heart, merged into the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke logaa mai tau mat kaa bhoraa ||
lines.translation: O people of the Lord, I am just a simple-minded fool.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਸੀ ਤਜਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਰਮਈਐ ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau tan kaasee tajahi kabeeraa ramaeeai kahaa nihoraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: If Kabeer were to leave his body at Benares, and so liberate himself, what obligation would he have to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer sunahu re loee bharam na bhoolahu koee ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, listen, O people - do not be deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਕਾਸੀ ਕਿਆ ਊਖਰੁ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਉ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa kaasee kiaa ookhar magahar raam ridai jau hoee ||2||3||
lines.translation: What is the difference between Benares and the barren land of Maghar, if the Lord is within one's heart? ||2||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਸਿਵ ਲੋਕਹਿ ਜੈਬੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: i(n)dr lok siv lokahi jaibo ||
lines.translation: Mortals may go to the Realm of Indra, or the Realm of Shiva,

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਛੇ ਤਪ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਐਬੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ochhe tap kar baahur aibo ||1||
lines.translation: but because of their hypocrisy and false prayers, they must leave again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa maa(n)gau kichh thir naahee ||
lines.translation: What should I ask for? Nothing lasts forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam rakh man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Enshrine the Lord's Name within your mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਭੈ ਬਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sobhaa raaj bibhai badiaaee ||
lines.translation: Fame and glory, power, wealth and glorious greatness

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t na kaahoo sa(n)g sahaaee ||2||
lines.translation: - none of these will go with you or help you in the end. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲਛਮੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: putr kalatr lachhamee maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Children, spouse, wealth and Maya

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: in te kahu kavanai sukh paaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: - who has ever obtained peace from these? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer avar nahee kaamaa ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, nothing else is of any use.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: hamarai man dhan raam ko naamaa ||4||4||
lines.translation: Within my mind is the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam simar raam simar raam simar bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Remember the Lord, remember the Lord, remember the Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਡਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam simaran bin boodate adhikaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without remembering the Lord's Name in meditation, a great many are drowned. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਦੇਹ ਗ੍ਰੇਹ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: banitaa sut deh greh sa(n)pat sukhadaaee ||
lines.translation: Your spouse, children, body, house and possessions - you think these will give you peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਨੑ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਲ ਅਵਧ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: inh mai kachh naahi tero kaal avadh aaee ||1||
lines.translation: But none of these shall be yours, when the time of death comes. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਗਜ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ajaamal gaj ganikaa patit karam keene ||
lines.translation: Ajaamal, the elephant, and the prostitute committed many sins,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਊ ਉਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: teoo utar paar pare raam naam leene ||2||
lines.translation: but still, they crossed over the world-ocean, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਕਰ ਕੂਕਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਤਊ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookar kookar jon bhrame taoo laaj na aaee ||
lines.translation: You have wandered in reincarnation, as pigs and dogs - did you feel no shame?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਛਾਡਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam chhaad a(n)mrit kaahe bikh khaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Forsaking the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, why do you eat poison? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਖੇਧ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj bharam karam bidh nikhedh raam naam lehee ||
lines.translation: Abandon your doubts about do's and dont's, and take to the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad jan kabeer raam kar sanehee ||4||5||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, O servant Kabeer, love the Lord. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree baanee bhagat naamadev jee kee ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਨੀਵ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਊਪਰਿ ਮੰਡਪ ਛਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaharee kar kai neev khudaaee oopar ma(n)dap chhaae ||
lines.translation: They dig deep foundations, and build lofty palaces.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਕੰਡੇ ਤੇ ਕੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਧਰਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਬਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: maaraka(n)de te ko adhikaaee jin trin dhar moo(n)d balaae ||1||
lines.translation: Can anyone live longer than Markanda, who passed his days with only a handful of straw upon his head? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamaro karataa raam sanehee ||
lines.translation: The Creator Lord is our only friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਨਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤ ਹਹੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe re nar garab karat hahu binas jaai jhoothee dehee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O man, why are you so proud? This body is only temporary - it shall pass away. ||1||Pause||
